tests.name: TestStaleOlderMetricDate
tests.root_cause: Test fixtures built SKUFactsIndex from AI key_skus with Revenue only and without Revenue7d/KeySKUCohort. Production KeySKU projection is cohort-owned, so sku_focus became empty while the index was non-empty → unified_dashboard_sku_focus_missing → bundle_validation_failed / publication_failed. Stale pointer assertions never reached a healthy newer publication.
tests.fix: Export dashboardfacts.BuildKeySKUCohortFacts; seed Revenue7d/Orders7d + KeySKUCohort + SKUMetricsDays in buildTestDashboardFacts / buildFixtureDashboardFacts; assert newer/healthy OutcomePublished before stale checks.

tests.name: TestSameSellerOutcomeSequence
tests.root_cause: Same KeySKU cohort seeding gap caused intermediate publications to fail validation, breaking deterministic same-seller outcome sequencing assertions.
tests.fix: Same KeySKU cohort fixture seeding as above.

tests.name: TestAsynqPublishE2E
tests.root_cause: Same KeySKU cohort seeding gap caused worker publish handler to fail bundle validation; task appeared unsuccessful under E2E polling.
tests.fix: Same KeySKU cohort fixture seeding; keep full enqueue→worker→DB lifecycle (no direct handler substitution).

tests.name: TestOzonEnrichmentSeedIntegration_RichIdempotent
tests.root_cause: Uniform MVP metrics made deriveStockScenarioFromFacts emit only ACTUAL. An earlier reshape invented available_stock counts and broke stocks-aggregate consistency.
tests.fix: prepareRichStockScenarios clears stocks for WAITING indexes and seeds positive stocks when missing; reshapeEnrichmentItemForScenario only adjusts DaysOfCover/OrdersCount; AvailableStockCount always mirrors stocks aggregate; sort SKUs for stable index assignment; test asserts against live aggregate.

tests.name: TestAIDataPackIntegration_AfterOzonEnrichmentSeed
tests.root_cause: Seller fixture had products/metrics but no stocks rows, so availableStock=0 forced every grade to WAITING_FOR_SUPPLY.
tests.fix: prepareRichStockScenarios seeds positive WH-A stock for non-WAITING rich indexes when aggregate is missing.
